modlog.title: Member timed out
modlog.body:
Case #{case} — {target} was timed out for {duration} by {moderator}
**Reason:** {reason}

error.notInServer: That user is not in this server.
error.invalidDuration: Invalid duration. Use a value like 5m, 10m, 1h, 6h, 1d, 7d or 28d (you can combine units, e.g. 2h30m).
error.tooLong: Timeouts cannot exceed 28 days (Discord's limit). Use the tempban system for longer durations.
error.needModerator: Timeouts longer than 1 hour require the moderator staff level.
error.missingPermissions: I'm missing permissions to do that. Please move my role above theirs in Server Settings → Roles and grant me the Moderate Members permission.
error.actionFailed: The timeout failed. Please check my permissions and role hierarchy, then try again.

warning.targetIsBot: Note: the target is a bot.

error.notInServer: That user is not in this server.
error.missingPermissions: I'm missing permissions to do that. Please move my role above theirs in Server Settings → Roles and grant me the Moderate Members permission.
error.actionFailed: Removing the timeout failed. Please check my permissions and role hierarchy, then try again.

untimeout.success: Case #{caseNumber} — the timeout on {user} was removed.

error.notInServer: That user is not in this server.
error.missingPermissions: I'm missing permissions to do that. Please move my role above theirs in Server Settings → Roles and grant me the Kick Members permission.
error.actionFailed: The kick failed. Please check my permissions and role hierarchy, then try again.
